SELECT e.*, lg.zone_id AS current_zone_id, gz.zone_name AS current_zone_name, CASE WHEN lg.zone_id IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN lg.zone_id <> e.snapshot_zone_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone_changed FROM inspection_exception e LEFT JOIN light_group lg ON lg.id = e.light_group_id LEFT JOIN garage_zone gz ON gz.id = lg.zone_id WHERE 1=1
AND e.batch_id = (SELECT id FROM inspection_batch WHERE batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchNo}, '%') LIMIT 1)
AND e.group_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{groupCode}, '%') AND e.exception_type = #{exceptionType} AND e.status = #{status} AND e.reporter LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reporter}, '%')
AND (CASE WHEN lg.zone_id IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN lg.zone_id <> e.snapshot_zone_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = #{zoneChanged}
ORDER BY e.reported_at DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT e.*, lg.zone_id AS current_zone_id, gz.zone_name AS current_zone_name, CASE WHEN lg.zone_id IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN lg.zone_id <> e.snapshot_zone_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone_changed FROM inspection_exception e LEFT JOIN light_group lg ON lg.id = e.light_group_id LEFT JOIN garage_zone gz ON gz.id = lg.zone_id WHERE e.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE inspection_exception SET status = 'CONFIRMED', review_opinion = #{reviewOpinion}, handle_deadline = #{handleDeadline}, reviewer = #{reviewer}, reviewed_at = #{now}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
